description: The thresholds of the failure-regime detector (research/failure-regimes.md), one source for every reader: tools/research/ai-battle/regimes.py loads them (RULES), battle.json fitness.regimes overrides any of them for the headless check, and `regimes.py --panel URL --post` writes them to the blackboard key regime.rules for Rhai services.

why.window_months: A regime lasts at least this many game months between its first and last sample: two game years, the fitness hoard window (8 quarterly samples span 21 months, so it is counted in elapsed months).
why.slack: Flat: the fleet's maximum stays within this fraction above its count at the run's start; the fitness rules' hoard_fleet_slack.
why.gap_factor: Material: over the span we lose at least this factor of value against the strongest rival relative to the median other rival.
why.pay_share: A mode underperforms when our profit a vehicle is below every rival running it and below this share of their median.
why.pay_years: Year ends in a row a mode must lose money or underperform.
why.plan_rounds: The planner's cycle: a plan is filed in one round, decided by the next and seen applied by the third.
why.gate: The regimes that fail the headless fitness check. mode_underperforms is a diagnosis: AAAHogEx, which won every recorded match, shows it for its road vehicles in 5 of the 6 fitness matches of master 2026-11-23. mode_never_pays fires on the default PrismaticAI on rival seed 1383023900 (its aircraft lose money), so gating it would fail every change until that is fixed. widening_gap is reported, not gated: master's bot at 42cae0fc33 shows it for the planned lineup in two of two fitness runs and for the default lineup in one of two (lundra, 2026-11-25, PR #266), so gating it would fail every change until PrismaticAI closes its gap to AAAHogEx.
